routes.label: at the Passport and Immigration Office or a sub-office

note: The fee for a new passport by age, as the Office's application guide gives it; a disabled person's Rs 400 isn't modelled. Validity, the processing time and the fee at a mission abroad aren't on the Office's pages, leads.

sources.title: Passport and Immigration Office, Mauritius, Application Guide
sources.said: Fees Payable Application for a Mauritius Passport – FEES YOU WOULD BE REQUIRED TO PAY New Passport Adult & Young Person – Rs 700 Minor (of age below 16 years) – Rs 400 Senior Citizen ( of age 55 years and above) – Rs 400 Disable person (To produce a certificate from the Ministry of Social Security) – Rs 400
